page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, full width. Printed page number "20" at the top. Catchword at the lower right. No running head, no marginal notes.

p.i: item, qui prorsus ignorabant, quando, & quo modo, & quare motus ille exortus fuisset, depositionem & anathematismum Nicolao divinitus instructo Papæ Romano per Zachariam Chalcedonis Metropolitam, & Theodorum Cariæ in Laodiceam promotum misit.

main_text.p: Has duas Synodos excepit Synodus contra Photium, quæ Oecumenica reipsa est, & inter Oecumenicas collocanda, licet dirumpantur Schismatici, cum Auctoritate Romani Pontificis, & reliquorum Patriarcharum, cum ipsius Summi Pontificis Oratores, & Senatus cum ipso Imperatore, & Antistites duo supra centum, & Sacerdotes reliqui interfuerint, & sententiam, & excommunicationem in Photium a Nicolao, & Adriano latam comprobaverint, & constabiliverint. Quod etiam ipsi Photiani agnoscunt, sed ut malo remedium afferant, in ea quæ subsecuta est Synodo, & quam ipsi etiamnum Photianam vocant, si tamen vera extitit ita, ut exarata in manuscriptis legitur, decreto suo sanxerunt, eam in nulla consideratione habendam esse. Et ut condemnatio plausibilior utrique parti accederet, etiam Synodum contra Ignatium ab eodem Photio coactam, novo astu, & contrario Universalis Ecclesiæ more diris devoverunt, Ἅ[?]παντα τὰ κ[?] τῆς ἁγίων Πα[?]τριαρχῶν

page.notes: Scan is slightly skewed; the bottom Greek line is faint and partly cut off at the right edge, so the Greek letters marked [?] are doubtful. The Greek word beginning the line after "deuouerunt" is only partly legible. The catchword "Γεγ-" is taken as the printed word at the right foot, with its hyphen. Some faint handwriting in the gutter near "Laodiceam" (a marginal pencil or ink mark) is not printed text and is left out. Spelling is as printed (e.g. "Oecumenica", "Schismatici", "Photianam"); long s and u/v were normalised as instructed. Small smudge near the lower left edge is not text.
